The levels that matter

  • Support — cluster: $183–188, where the 50-day ($183.36), the 23.6% Fib ($187.79) and last week's low ($184.45) line up. That zone held on Oct 16.
  • Deeper support: $172.23 (38.2%).
  • Resistance: the 20-day at ~$194.50, then the $212.94 record. A close above targets the 127.2% extension at $241.93.

Earnings: Mon Nov 2, 2026 (EPS est. ~$0.38).

Edge study: PLTR's strong upward drift dominates. Buying on any day averaged +8.6% over 20 days. Dip setups averaged even more (+13.7% for RSI dips) but with only a 50% win rate: big wins, frequent losses. Size small and let winners run.
